name: Completed Passes
description: The total number of successful pass completions by the team.

name: Passing Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the team through completed passes.

name: Longest Pass
description: The longest single pass completion by the team in the game.

name: Passing Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the team through passing plays.

name: Intercepted Passes
description: The number of passes thrown by the team that were intercepted by the opposing defense.

name: Pass Attempts
description: The total number of times the team attempted a forward pass.

name: Times Sacked
description: The number of times the team's quarterback was sacked while attempting to pass.

name: Sack Yards Lost
description: The total number of yards lost by the team due to sacks.

name: Receptions
description: The total number of completed catches made by the team's receivers.

name: Receiving Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the team through receptions.

name: Longest Reception
description: The longest single reception made by a player on the team.

name: Receiving Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the team via receptions.

name: Rushing Attempts
description: The total number of times the team attempted a rushing play.

name: Net Rushing Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the team on rushing plays, subtracting any yards lost.

name: Rushing Yards Gained
description: The total number of yards gained by the team on rushing plays before any losses.

name: Longest Rush
description: The longest single rushing play executed by the team.

name: Rushing Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the team on rushing plays.

name: Rushing Yards Lost
description: The total number of yards lost by the team on rushing plays.

name: Total First Downs
description: The total number of first downs achieved by the team.

name: First Downs by Rushing
description: The number of first downs achieved by the team through rushing plays.

name: First Downs by Passing
description: The number of first downs achieved by the team through passing plays.

name: First Downs by Penalty
description: The number of first downs awarded to the team due to penalties committed by the opposing team.

name: Third Down Attempts
description: The total number of times the team attempted a play on third down.

name: Third Down Conversions
description: The total number of times the team successfully converted a third down attempt into a first down.

name: Fourth Down Attempts
description: The total number of times the team attempted a play on fourth down.

name: Fourth Down Conversions
description: The total number of times the team successfully converted a fourth down attempt into a first down.

name: Fumbles Lost
description: The total number of times the team fumbled the ball and lost possession.

name: Total Fumbles
description: The total number of fumbles committed by the team, regardless of whether possession was lost.

name: Total Penalties
description: The total number of penalties committed by the team.

name: Penalty Yards
description: The total number of yards lost due to penalties committed by the team.

name: Red Zone Attempts
description: The total number of times the team reached the opponent's red zone (inside the 20-yard line).

name: Red Zone Scores
description: The number of times the team successfully scored (touchdown or field goal) after entering the red zone.

name: Red Zone Points
description: The total number of points scored by the team from red zone possessions.

name: Red Zone Rushing Touchdowns
description: The number of touchdowns the team scored by rushing inside the red zone.

name: Red Zone Passing Touchdowns
description: The number of touchdowns the team scored by passing inside the red zone.

name: Red Zone Field Goals Made
description: The total number of field goals successfully made from red zone possessions.

name: Red Zone Field Goal Attempts
description: The total number of field goal attempts the team made from red zone possessions.

name: Red Zone Turnovers on Downs
description: The number of times the team failed to convert a fourth down in the red zone, losing possession.

name: Red Zone Interceptions
description: The number of times the team threw an interception inside the red zone.

name: Red Zone Fumbles Lost
description: The number of times the team fumbled and lost possession inside the red zone.

name: Red Zone End of Half
description: The number of times a red zone possession ended due to the end of the half.

name: Red Zone End of Game
description: The number of times a red zone possession ended due to the end of the game.

name: Miscellaneous Yards
description: The total number of yards gained or lost by the team in plays classified as miscellaneous.

name: Time of Possession
description: The total amount of time the team controlled the ball during the game.

name: Onside Kick Attempts
description: The total number of onside kick attempts made by the team.

name: Onside Kicks Recovered
description: The number of successful onside kicks recovered by the team.

name: Points off Turnovers
description: The total number of points scored by the team after forcing a turnover.

name: Assisted Tackles
description: The number of tackles where the defender contributed but did not make the solo tackle.

name: Solo Tackles
description: The number of tackles made solely by a defender without assistance.

name: Total Tackles
description: The total number of tackles made by the team, including solo and assisted tackles.

name: Interceptions
description: The number of passes intercepted by the team's defense.

name: Interception Return Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the team after intercepting a pass.

name: Pass Breakups
description: The number of times the team successfully defended a pass without intercepting it.

name: Unassisted Sacks
description: The number of times a single defender sacked the opposing quarterback.

name: Assisted Sacks
description: The number of times multiple defenders contributed to sacking the quarterback.

name: Total Sacks
description: The total number of quarterback sacks made by the team's defense.

name: Sack Yards
description: The total number of yards lost by the opposing team due to sacks made by the defense.

name: Quarterback Hurries
description: The number of times the team's defense forced the quarterback to throw early due to pressure.

name: Forced Fumbles
description: The number of times the team forced the opposing player to fumble the ball.

name: Fumbles Recovered
description: The number of fumbles recovered by the team, regardless of who forced them.

name: Fumble Return Yards
description: The total number of yards gained after recovering a fumble.

name: Fumble Return Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the team after recovering a fumble.

name: Kicks Blocked By
description: The total number of kicks (field goals or extra points) blocked by the player during the game.

name: Assisted Tackles for Loss
description: The number of tackles for loss where multiple defenders contributed.

name: Solo Tackles for Loss
description: The number of tackles for loss made solely by a defender.

name: Total Tackles for Loss
description: The total number of tackles resulting in negative yardage for the opposing team.

name: Tackle for Loss Yards
description: The total number of yards lost by the opposing team due to tackles for loss.

name: Interception Return Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the team after intercepting a pass.

name: Interception Return Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the team after intercepting a pass.

name: Longest Interception Return
description: The longest single interception return made by the team.

name: Interceptions Made
description: The total number of passes intercepted by the team's defense.

name: Field Goals Made
description: The total number of successful field goals made by the team.

name: Field Goals Attempted
description: The total number of field goal attempts made by the team.

name: Longest Field Goal Made
description: The longest field goal successfully made by the team.

name: Blocked Field Goals
description: The total number of field goal attempts blocked by the opposing team.

name: PAT Kicks Attempted
description: The total number of extra point kicks attempted after touchdowns.

name: PAT Kicks Made
description: The total number of successful extra point kicks made after touchdowns.

name: PAT Pass Attempts
description: The total number of pass attempts on a two-point conversion play after a touchdown.

name: PAT Pass Completions
description: The number of successful pass attempts on a two-point conversion play.

name: PAT Rush Attempts
description: The total number of rushing attempts on a two-point conversion play.

name: PAT Rush Completions
description: The number of successful rushing attempts on a two-point conversion play.

name: Total Kickoffs
description: The total number of times the team kicked off to start a drive.

name: Kickoff Yards
description: The total number of yards gained on all kickoffs.

name: Kickoff Touchbacks
description: The number of kickoffs that resulted in a touchback.

name: Kickoffs Out of Bounds
description: The number of kickoffs that went out of bounds, resulting in a penalty.

name: Kick Returns
description: The total number of kickoffs returned by the team.

name: Kick Return Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the team on kickoff returns.

name: Kick Return Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored on kickoff returns.

name: Longest Kick Return
description: The longest single kickoff return by the team.

name: Total Punts
description: The total number of times the team punted the ball.

name: Punting Yards
description: The total number of yards gained on all punts.

name: Punts of 50+ Yards
description: The number of punts that traveled at least 50 yards.

name: Punts Inside 20
description: The number of punts that landed inside the opponent's 20-yard line.

name: Longest Punt
description: The longest single punt made by the team.

name: Punt Touchbacks
description: The number of punts that resulted in a touchback.

name: Fair Catches on Punts
description: The number of punts where the receiving team called a fair catch.

name: Blocked Punts
description: The number of punts that were blocked by the opposing team.

name: Punt Returns
description: The total number of punts returned by the team.

name: Punt Return Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the team on punt returns.

name: Punt Return Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored on punt returns.

name: Longest Punt Return
description: The longest single punt return made by the team.

name: Total Touchdowns
description: The total number of touchdowns scored by the team across all types of plays.

name: Total Field Goals Made
description: The total number of successful field goals made by the team.

name: Total PAT Kicks Made
description: The total number of successful extra point kicks made by the team.

name: Passing Yards Per Attempt
description: The average number of yards gained per passing attempt by the team.

name: Pass Completion Percentage
description: The percentage of pass attempts completed by the team.

name: Average Rushing Yards
description: The average number of net yards gained per rushing attempt by the team.

name: Average Yards per Reception
description: The average number of yards gained per reception by the team.

name: Takeaways
description: The number of times the team recovered a fumble or intercepted a pass.

name: Field Goal Percentage
description: The percentage of field goal attempts successfully made by the team.

name: Kickoffs Returned
description: The number of kickoffs returned by the team.

name: Average Punt Return Yards
description: The average number of yards gained per punt return by the team.

name: Net Kickoff Yards
description: The total net yards gained on kickoffs by the special teams unit.

name: Average Punt Yards
description: The average number of yards per punt made by the team.

name: Total Offensive Yards
description: The total number of yards gained by the team on offense.

name: All-Purpose Yards
description: The total yards gained by the team from rushing, receiving, and returns.
